{{Quote|Are you deaf and dumb? Get going!|Markan sends an acolyte to receive martial training|<ref name="SWTOR:AFC" />}}
'''Markan''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who achieved the rank of assistant [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], between them and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Markan worked in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the war, and whilst there served under [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] such as [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Zash|Zash]]. Zash ordered him to direct acolytes training at the academy to instructors in the archives, who would teach them martial skills.<ref name="SWTOR:AFC" /> One acolyte he directed to the instructors was the [[Sith Inquisitor]] who would go on to become Zash's [[Darth Nox|apprentice]], who Markan directed to the Sith Lord [[Samus]].

After the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], when [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]] surrendered the Sith Empire to the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], Markan quit his position as Overseer and left the Sith Academy out of disgust, and eventually wound up residing on [[Port Nowhere]].<ref name="Nowhere">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Road to Nowhere|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref>  

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}

==Personality and traits==
He saw [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] as inferior to Humans and members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], but tolerated them under orders from his superiors.
He had pale skin, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black hair and whilst working in the academy he wore black and red [[Sith apparel|robes]].<ref name="SWTOR:AFC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Harkun always had the worst to say about you. His opinions were widely shared among the Overseers. It's apparent that you have surpassed our expectations for you.|Markan reunites with Darth Nox on Port Nowhere|<ref name="Nowhere" />}}
Markan first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which he played a part in the quest "A Fighting Chance". The quest was for the Sith Inquisitor class only and directed them to a class trainer. If the player is a non-Human or Sith species Markan will comment on how disgusting he finds them. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].

Markan can later appear in the "Chains in the Dark" Imperial storyline on [[Port Nowhere]], where he directs the player to meet with [[Gizmel Gam]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], though only if the player is a Sith Warrior or Inquisitor. He can experience unique dialogue if the player is a Sith Inquisitor who previously did his mission on Korriban. For Jedi players, the Port Nowhere contact is [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cedral Gend]].<ref name="Nowhere" />
